title: Ikala character item
description: How an equippable item looks: a layer part it is worn as, or a mesh held in a socket, for each body plan. Gameplay items name one of these for their look.

Attach.description: How a held mesh sits in a socket.

offset.description: Its offset from the socket, in meters.

rotate.description: Its rotation from the socket, in degrees about x, y and z.

FxUse.description: An effect placed on a character: which effect, the bone or socket it follows, and tuning.

bone.description: The bone it follows, like "hand.R". Give a bone or a socket.

socket.description: The socket it follows, like "head_top". Give a bone or a socket.

offset.description: Its offset from the bone or socket, in meters, in the bone's space, up to 1.27 each way.

color.description: The palette channel that tints it, like "accent". Left out, it keeps the effect's own colors.

scale.description: Its size and speed, times the effect's, above 0 and up to 4.

rate.description: How many particles it spawns, times the effect's, 0 to 4.

intensity.description: How brightly it glows, times the effect's, 0 to 4.

when.description: When it shows: "always", "moving", "combat", or a toggle that gameplay or the player controls, like "wings". Lowercase words joined by dots, up to 32 letters.

to.description: The other end of a line it spawns along, like a blade's tip, in the same space as the offset and up to 1.27 m each way. Left out, it spawns at a point.

turn.description: Whether its spawn area and direction turn with its bone, like sparks off a blade. Left out, they keep to the world, so flames rise.

Item.description: How an equippable item looks: a layer part it is worn as, or a mesh held in a socket, for each body plan. Gameplay items name one of these for their look.

slots.description: The equipment slots it goes in, like ["mainHand"].

category.description: What kind of thing it is, like "sword.2h".

looks.description: How it looks on each plan, by plan ID.

dyeChannels.description: The palette channels it can be dyed in, like ["primary", "accent"].

tags.description: Tags that editors filter by, like "weapon".

extends.description: The ID of a definition of the same kind to start from. Fields written here replace the parent's, and objects merge field by field.

Look.description: How an item looks on one plan: worn as a layer part, or held as a mesh in a socket.

part.description: The layer part it is worn as, like a helmet.

mesh.description: The mesh it is held as, like "weapons/sword.glb#sword", relative to its namespace's content folder, with its grip at the origin.

states.description: Where a held item goes in each state, like {"drawn": "grip.R", "sheathed": "back"}, as socket names or types. The first is where it starts.

attach.description: How a held mesh sits in each socket or socket type, like {"back": {...}}.

hidesLayers.description: Layers it hides, like a helmet hiding hair.

hidesRegions.description: Mask regions of the body it hides.

style.description: The way the character moves with it, like "ikala:style/weapon/two_handed_melee".

fx.description: Effects it carries, like a glowing blade. On a held item, an effect with no bone or socket sits on the item, with offsets in its mesh's space.
